text: This is a request for documents from the Canada Revenue Agency, about the Canada child benefit. CRA is asking you to send some documents: a copy of your lease or rental agreement, and a letter from your child's school or daycare. Send them through CRA Submit documents online. The deadline is October 14, 2026. That is 17 days from today. If you have questions, call CRA at 1-800-387-1193.
